summary: Dispatcher-style mapper: given mode a2 (0 or 1), flag a4, and event parameter a3 (1-24), selects one of four switch tables (jpt_4124C4, jpt_4125BB, jpt_4126A4, jpt_4128B8) and computes a mapped value v6 in the 236-387 range. The two a2==0 tables further branch on flag a5 to pick between a high and a low value. On a recognized (a2, a4, a3) combination the mapped value is written to the output buffer at a1+8, the value returned by sub_414180(a2) is written at a1+12, and 1 is returned; any unrecognized input returns -1. The event-to-driver-model-index naming is carried from the packet's existing analysis.

operations.description: Initialize result to -1 as the failure sentinel before any dispatch.
Dispatch on a2: only a2 == 1 and a2 == 0 are handled; any other a2 leaves result at -1.
Within each a2 branch, flag a4 selects one of two switch tables.
a2==1, a4==1: switch table at jpt_4124C4 maps a3 1-24 to values 275-297 and 299; case 8 jumps to the shared 282 label of the sibling table.
a2==1, a4==0: switch table at jpt_4125BB maps a3 1-24 to values 282, 298 and 300-322; case 8 is the shared 282 label reached by the sibling table.
a2==0, a4==1: switch table at jpt_4126A4 maps a3 1-22 to a5-dependent values (340-361 when a5 is set, 294-315 otherwise), a3 23 to 236 and a3 24 to 237.
a2==0, a4==0: switch table at jpt_4128B8 maps a3 1-22 to a5-dependent values (366-387 when a5 is set, 316-337 otherwise), and a3 23/24 both to 262.
Shared success label: write the mapped value v6 to the output buffer at a1+8.
Call sub_414180(a2) to compute the secondary value.
Write the result of sub_414180(a2) to the output buffer at a1+12.
Set result to 1 to signal a successful mapping.
Return -1 on an unrecognized a3 (default switch cases) or an out-of-range a2; otherwise return 1.
